name: money-float-column
title: money field typed Float/Decimal (must be integer minor units)
detail: Money must be stored + computed as integer minor units (fils/cents), never Float/Decimal — float math silently loses precision on amounts and produces off-by-a-fraction charges/refunds/ledger drift. A Prisma schema field named like a money amount typed Float or Decimal is the root sink.
fix: store the amount as Int (minor units, e.g. fils); do all math in integers via the centralized money helper; convert to display units only at the edge.
